sql:
WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-89.021261 44.460738, -89.021477 44.446139, -89.041988 44.446352, -89.041767 44.460848, -89.021261 44.460738))', 4326) AS g
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(rast)) AS s
  FROM clipped
)
SELECT (s).max - (s).min AS elevation
FROM stats;
